Computed: radius 0px, active row bg transparent, stroke 0.52px = shared emphasis, scale 1.04, colour accent; inactive row stroke 0/scale 1; no new hover rule (.is-highlighted only reuses the shared :is(...) rule). Hand token check of command-palette.css: raw values are top 12vh, width min(560px,calc(100vw - space-5*2)), max-height min(420px,70vh), z-index 60, line-height 1.45, 1px borders, translateX(-50%), font-weight 600 -- all layout/geometry, none is a 4-32px padding/margin/gap/font-size; all paddings/gaps/fonts/colours/durations/ease/elevation/shadow are var() tokens. OK. Padding-right space-5 (24px): needed (4% of a 560px row = ~22px) and tight but sufficient; at narrower widths the grow is smaller so safe. Enter order restoreFocus->onClose->run is right (command that moves focus wins; close effect's second restoreFocus is a no-op since opener is cleared). Screenshots, all opened: shot-light-plain: filter s, New section active blue, hints right-aligned, unclipped; shot-light-color: same, slightly different blue; shot-dark-plain: active light blue, headings muted, square raised surface; shot-dark-color: same brighter blue; empty-light-plain/empty-light-color/empty-dark-plain/empty-dark-color: 'zzz' shows muted 'No matching commands', no rows, square. Notes (non-blocking): (1) the active row's hint sits ~21px further right than other hints, 3px from the panel edge, because the whole row grows from its left; cosmetic, not clipped. (2) z-index 60 is below .modal-backdrop 70 (styles.css:1235): E3w should check opening the palette while a modal is open, and that it does not stack under the sidebar overlay (60, same level). (3) Palette does not close on outside click (author noted). (4) Add command-palette.css to designTokens SWEPT when convenient. (5) Pre-existing stray folder /Users/ethansiegel/Local%20Projects/VC%20Projects still exists outside workspace; my run created nothing new. E3w must add commandPalette to runAppAction + keydown, build commands with hint=formatChord/hintFor, pass animateIn only for pointer opens, mount once.
